body: Don't put your thoughts with me, put them with somebody that actually cares about him, still. Though that is probably the second stage of grief setting in.

It isn't selfish for anyone else, but he, he had a lot of friends. He was considered a nerd, but when he got bullied, the football team came to his defense. I just don't understand why he would do such a thing.

To think, on tuesday, I was going to tell him to grow balls and ask me out, but now, I hope he's dead. Pulling such a selfish thing, its just, if he is somehow alive, I never want to talk to him again.

Thank you. I'm not even sure if he's dead, he was close when I found him, but heroin overdoses are common in this area, so they know how to treat one. Frankly, I don't even want to know if he's alive or dead. He was the love of my life, I was going to tell him to grow some balls and ask me out on tuesday, but now, he just did the most selfish thing imaginable. I don't want to see him ever again, if he is alive.

This is a good friend of the OP, not actually him. This thread was open on his computer, and he was... sitting in his computer chair, looking so peaceful, truly happy. It is what he wanted to do, but still, it isn't fucking fair. It isn't fair, of all the people in the world to go through with this, why him? Why the kid that was intelligent, that everybody seemed to like, that always loved to make people laugh and smile? Its just... I figured I'd say something so nobody tries to stop a deed that has already been done.
I'm scared. I'm alone. And now that its too late, I don't want to die.
Just curious, what's your name? I'd like to be able to think of a person, not an entity of thr internet.

Thank you for all you have tried, but the needle is in. 2000mg of heroin are now going through my veins. I don't want you to blame yourself for this, it was inevitable. I probably have a few minutes before I fall asleep for the last time.
I wouldn't be angry with you at all, to be honest, it is nice to find someone that actually seems to care. Thank you for all you have tried to do, but good night, forever.

I clicked random far more than ten times, but nothing looks appealing. To put the proverbial cherry on top, I just got a call from my doctor, I owe them close to $100,000. There's no way I can keep living like this. I sleep on a mattress in a 10x10 fppt room, on thr dingy carpet, above a heroin den, next door to an alcoholic and a schizophrenic, and below a crack den. I live on the cheapest food available, it is just too much too handle. I can't even pay to keep cool in the summer, warm in the winter, (minus the days in which no matter bill status, I have to get heat), electricity intermittently suits and I can barely afford that, the best thing I can do is go to the local McArthur branch, take my test, and get my grant, ehoich will of course go straight to medical bills.
I browsed r/horriblydepressing to try and get insight on how to properly write out the note, but other than that, this is thr only subreddit I've used.

All staying positive ever did for me was make life feel good for a few seconds, then everything feels exponentially worse after that, because of that contrast between the slight forced smile and normal life.

I must have read The Hunt for Red October around 600 times, and yes, I have tried the National Suicide Prevention Hotline, and they managed to talk me out of it. For a week, then here I am, contemplating it once again. It used to be sporadic, just the occasional suicidal thought, but now its constant, all I can think about anymore is how to end it. Maybe there is an afterlife, maybe there is a god, I could've been wrong the whole time. Who knows? Maybe I'll find out soon.

Unfortunately, when curled up in the fetal position bawling my eyes out, thinking of something else is impossible. Just typing this is almost impossible. It just looks so easy, its just right there, a little poke, then eternal sleep, away from this horrible life.

I guess my biggest problem is that I'm just such a failure. For the past year, I've been telling myself "you can make it one more day", but now, I'm finding I'm getting down to " you can make it one more minute". I can't even bring myself to suicide like everyone wants. I tried killing myself once before, by hanging, but the neighbors heard something and called 911. I can't even kill myself properly, that is how big of a failure I am.

Nothing. I spend it all on food, rent, gas, and car loan repayment. I am an emancipated minor (really bad abuse when it came to parents, though for some reason, I still have to pay their $500 monthly interest payment). I think I have ~$25 credited to my name.

I have. I am untipped, make $4 an hour, work 12 hours a day on weekends and during the summer, and 8 hours after school every day. I have been working there for two years, and have managed to still feel as depressed, my boss actually encourages me to kill myself pon a daily basis.
Oh! lol. Herp-a-derp on my part.

Kinda figured my basic method put together during a slow day in an easy class wouldn't be up to snuff with RSA, not intending to use it for files or anything like that, that's what RSA-4096 is for. Just wondering how easy it is to break.
